myDayNoteId.label: My Day Note
myDayNoteId.description: The note that collects today's tasks. Adding a suggestion appends it here, and tasks already linked here stop being suggested.

addTasksWhenDue.label: Add Tasks When Due
addTasksWhenDue.description: File tasks into the My Day note as their start time arrives. Requires agenda@beatlink, which supplies the task list.

sendDueNotifications.label: Send Due Notifications
sendDueNotifications.description: Send a desktop notification as each task's start time arrives. Requires agenda@beatlink, which supplies the task list.
